import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def compute_gcd_precond (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def gcdAux (a b : UInt64) : UInt64 :=
  if h : b = 0 then a
  else gcdAux b (a % b)
termination_by b.toNat
decreasing_by
  have hb : 0 < b.toNat := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b.toNat with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd (by simpa using (UInt64.toNat_inj.mp (by simpa using h0))) h
    · exact h0
  have : (a % b).toNat = a.toNat % b.toNat := by simp
  rw [this]
  exact Nat.mod_lt _ hb
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def compute_gcd (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  gcdAux a b
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def compute_gcd_postcond (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (result : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.toNat = Nat.gcd (UInt64.toNat a) (UInt64.toNat b)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem gcdAux_toNat (a b : UInt64) :
    (gcdAux a b).toNat = Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat := by
  fun_induction gcdAux a b with
  | case1 a => simp
  | case2 a b h ih =>
    have hb : 0 < b.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b.toNat with h0 | h0
      · exact absurd (UInt64.toNat_inj.mp (by simpa using h0)) h
      · exact h0
    rw [ih]
    have hmod : (a % b).toNat = a.toNat % b.toNat := by simp
    rw [hmod, Nat.gcd_comm b.toNat (a.toNat % b.toNat), ← Nat.gcd_rec, Nat.gcd_comm]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem compute_gcd_postcond_satisfied (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) :
    compute_gcd_postcond a b (compute_gcd a b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  simpa [compute_gcd] using gcdAux_toNat a b
  -- !benchmark @end proof
